events.title: THAW
events.location: Surfers Paradise Beach & Hota Lake Precinct

events.title: VOICES
events.description: Created by Adelaide based design studio, Pulsing Heart, VOICES celebrates connection and play through music. Spin a tube to bring this light and sound sculpture to life. With all fifty tubes spinning, hear the Sydney Philharmonia Choirs echo through your city street. VOICES is activated through audience participation. Fifty translucent tubes create an ovular wall of light and sound. As each tube spins, a corresponding voice fades in, it’s volume correlating with the increasing height of an internal light. As layers are added, the sound and lightscape increase in intensity until the choir is heard in its entirety. VOICES invites diverse communities to gather, participate and connect. Multi sensory output, step free physical access and intuitive design ensures VOICES is a experience for all people, regardless of age, ability, culture or socio-economic background. Allowing participation from upwards of 100 people simultaneously, VOICES eliminates lines and promises an aspirational shared experience.

events.title: Rekindle, Rekindle
events.description: Rekindle, Rekindle is an experimental film by Gold Coast skateboarder, actor, stunt performer, artist and filmmaker Sarah Huston. Redefining the phrase “skate and destroy,” Huston reframes skateboarding’s masculine associations with destruction through a cyclical, regenerative and nurturing feminist lens. Shot on Super 8, the film follows a skateboarder through a ritual of friction, motion, impact and fire. Through repetition, skateboarding becomes a meditation on destruction and creation, exploring what it means to push the body to its limit, again and again. Time: From 10am

events.title: সুন্দরী SHUNDORI
events.description: Be enveloped in the vivid and sometimes surreal world of acclaimed filmmaker and video artist Naina Sen’s large-scale, conceptual video works. Created over five years between India and Australia, this sensorial experience deconstructs and reconstructs the idea of the Indian feminine through stylised, futurist metaphorical re-imaginings of Indian feminist mythology, contemporary cultural and ritualistic practices and personal storytelling. Accompanied by a layered soundscape of field recordings, women’s songs, spoken word and a textural score, সুন্দরী SHUNDORI is a multi-projection, multi-channel, multi-lingual video installation that turns the space into an immersive portal of bold and intimate exploration of contemporary South Asian identity. A long term collaborative work between the artist and over 500 womxn across India and the Indian diaspora in Australia, সুন্দরী SHUNDORI is Naina Sen’s first major exhibition of video works. Times: 1-11 Oct, from 10am

events.title: The Butterfly Who Flew Into The Rave
events.description: This electrifying performance explores rave culture in a hypnotic hour-long spectacle of pure endurance. This award-winning durational work is choreographed to the techno album 'Nocturbulous Behaviour' by Suburban Knights and straddles the border between performance art, dance, and theatre. Three dancers are locked in a pattern of relentless movement, in seamless synch, detailed down to every beat. It’s the come up and the come down all in one - the beauty of feeling alive, but the consequences that come with it. The dancers embody the obsession of rave culture, perfectly capturing the communal joy and the physical toll of dancing until you drop. Indulge in the pain, the sweat, the cathartic mess; a display of pure endurance to achieve a goal. A spectacle of the human body as a victim to music, as a victim to passion, as a victim to our endless desire to achieve more. To win and win again.

events.title: A Simple Space
events.description: Backed by the driving rhythm of a live percussionist, seven acrobats push their physical limits again and again without reserve. Simultaneously raw, frantic and joyful, A Simple Space evokes real responses in audiences, something visceral rather than cerebral. Instead of fine-tuning the performance with makeup, lighting and contrived theatrical overlay, the cast has deliberately gone the opposite way focusing on their exceptional skill, playful competitiveness, trust and friendship. The audience is brought in close to surround the performers. You can feel the heat, hear every breath, and be immersed in every moment. This honesty is the essence behind A Simple Space.

events.title: 100 Keyboards
events.description: 100 toy keyboards. A shimmering field of sound exploring the acoustic phenomena of interference, resonance, and the subtle beauty of imperfect tuning. Because no two keyboards are tuned exactly alike, the overlapping tones generate evolving patterns, beating frequencies, and shifting harmonic textures. Like an auditory moiré, these layers of sound continually interact, creating a sonic landscape that is constantly changing as to where you are seated. Or simply turn your head—and the music transforms around you. Every listening position reveals new harmonies, pulses, and textures as the sounds combine in different ways. Each listener experiences a unique sonic perspective, discovering details that exist only from where they are seated. Immersive, hypnotic, and endlessly evolving, this is an invitation to slow down, listen deeply, and lose yourself in a living landscape of sound.

events.title: CYVASA 2.0
events.description: CYVASA 2.0 is an experimental dance work by Indonesian and diaspora dance artists Juliet Widyasari Burnett and Ishvara Devati, with a music score by Indonesian feminist noise duo Metatesis. In the world of CYVASA 2.0, ancient Javanese spirituality merges with techno-fantasy aesthetics and glitch distortion. The trans and cis female bodies are dynamic, sacred entities from this speculative future, untethered from patriarchal history. Here, desire is a driving force that transforms the body’s architecture - a pulsating, liquid machine that is continuously upgrading, reprogrammed and reincarnated. This is not a stage, but a temple, laboratory and server room, where new digital deities are born.

events.title: Ocker
events.description: Join us for the world premiere of Ocker, a show in motion from leading First Nations company Na Djinang Circus. Ocker is a roving circus show tearing through the precinct on a portable railway track built in real time. This modern-day hunting party weaves through crowds, laying track wherever the chase leads. Charging forward with single-minded determination, they drag the audience along for the ride. The park becomes a playground for strange encounters, risky acrobatics, and absurd acts of endurance as circus erupts in the most unexpected places. Improvised scenes constantly derail the hunt as the troupe negotiates crowds, obstacles, and their own terrible ideas. Swept up in the chaos of the chase, Ocker waits for nobody. Keeping up is entirely your responsibility.

events.title: Artist Talk with Claudio Kirac, Morag Myerscough & Naina Sen
events.description: Come gather under the bright bold BEACON of belonging for an illuminating conversation and rare insight into the creative practice from cross-disciplinary artist Claudio Kirac, Kaleidoscope Skies, International acclaimed UK artist and designer, Morag Myerscough, BEACON and world acclaimed filmmaker and video artist Naina Sen, Shundori. This artist talk will be hosted by Kate Baggerson, Executive Director, Co-Founder and Artistic Director of Everybody NOW! - creators of participatory arts experiences that generate joy. Everybody NOW! are nationally recognised for their ability to create highly professional and innovative arts projects, with high-impact community benefits. For anyone interested in large-scale community arts projects, storytelling, placemaking and cross-cultural collaborations, creative process and the journey to bring joy, hope and connection. This will be an insightful and inspiring experience - join us!

events.title: Footnote: A Yeah Girl Retrospective
events.description: 2026 marks ten years of the women’s skateboarding media platform, Yeah Girl, which was founded on the Gold Coast and first launched as part of BLEACH Festival in 2016. Footnote: A Yeah Girl Retrospective is a short documentary film celebrating Yeah Girl’s legacy and influence on global skateboarding culture. The screening is followed by a panel discussion featuring prominent women from the skateboarding industry, moderated by Yeah Girl founder, Sarah Huston. The panel will discuss topics including the rise of women’s skateboarding over the last decade on the Gold Coast and globally, the success of local skateboarders on the world stage, the impact of the Olympics on skateboarding culture, and more.

events.title: World Percussion Workshop
events.description: Join Kombumerri Traditional Owner, Lann Levinge, and Turkish musician, Atman, for an immersive cross-cultural music workshop that blends didgeridoo practice with world percussion traditions. Through cultural storytelling and hands-on participation, participants will explore the significance of sound, rhythm, and connection to Country while learning foundational techniques in didgeridoo, percussion, and rhythm-making. Instruments may include didgeridoo, clapsticks, darbuka, frame drums, tabla, and cajón. NB: Participants are required to bring their own percussion instruments. Didgeridoo's will be provided.

events.title: Step by Step
events.description: Time to get jiggy in the land of 1000 dances! A fully immersive dance party packed with the songs and moves spanning the last century from the Macarena to YMCA, from the Conga to the Time Warp. Step By Step is a brand new dancealong journey through pop culture history. No matter your skill-level, check your inhibitions at the door and celebrate movement and music together. Time to shake your tail feather! This free, interactive dance experience is designed for people of all ages to move and enjoy together. The performance invites audiences to join in, so please participate safely and only attempt movements that are within your own comfort and ability level.
